promise: A lesson plan in 1 minute from your KTP
intro: Upload your calendar and thematic plan (KTP) as a .docx. Bilig checks the dates and hours, links each lesson to a Bilig topic and builds the official lesson plan in one click.

upload.notDocx: This is not a .docx file. Save the KTP in Word as “Word Document (.docx)” and try again.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.

list.title: My KTPs
list.empty: No KTPs yet. Upload your first one: its lessons and dates will appear here.
list.confirmDelete: Delete the KTP “{{title}}”? Plans you have already downloaded stay on your computer.

issue.no_lessons: No lesson table was found in the file
issue.date_order: {{date}} is earlier than the previous lesson ({{prev}})
issue.date_same_day: A second lesson on the same day ({{date}})
issue.hours_mismatch: The header says {{declared}} hours, but the lessons add up to {{actual}}
issue.section_hours_mismatch: The section is declared as {{declared}} h, but its lessons take {{actual}} h

plan.notFound: This KTP was not found. It may have been deleted.
plan.noRows: No lessons were found in this file. Check that the KTP has a table with lesson titles and dates.
plan.noProblems: No problems in the lessons of {{class}}.

week.title: This week · {{class}}
week.tooMany: The week has more than {{max}} lessons: download it in parts below

action.planFor: Download the plan of lesson {{n}} for {{class}} (.docx)

range.title: Plans for several lessons in one file
range.hint: Tick lessons (Shift+click selects a range) or enter their numbers.
range.tooMany: At most {{max}} lessons in one file

draftNote: Every plan is a draft: check it and choose the competency codes before the lesson.
conflict: The KTP was changed elsewhere. We loaded the latest version: check your edit and make it again.
downloadError: Could not build the plan. Try again.
